D/ ANTONINVS AVG PIVS [PP] TRP XVIII ; R/ BRITA[NNI]A COS IIII SC in

A Roman copper alloy coin: dupondius of Antoninus Pius (AD154-155). RIC no. 1971. Mint: Rome. Reverse: BRITA[NNI]A COS IIII SC in the exergue. Reece period 7. Obverse: Laureate bust right. Obverse inscription: ANTONINVS AVG PIVS [PP] TRP XVIII. Reverse: Britannia, wearing cloak and breeches, seated left on rock, head propped on right hand, left hand resting on rock: in front, large round shield…
